CHART CODE
 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Education_Stage': [
        'Primary Enrollment',
        'Primary Enrollment',
        'Primary Completion',
        'Primary Completion',
        'Lower Secondary Enrollment',
        'Lower Secondary Enrollment',
        'Lower Secondary Completion',
        'Lower Secondary Completion',
        'Upper Secondary Enrollment',
        'Upper Secondary Enrollment',
        'Upper Secondary Completion',
        'Upper Secondary Completion',
        'Tertiary Enrollment',
        'Tertiary Enrollment',
        'Tertiary Completion',
        'Tertiary Completion'
    ],
    'Region': [
        'Gulf Countries',
        'Gulf MENA Region',
        'Gulf Countries',
        'Gulf MENA Region',
        'Gulf Countries',
        'Gulf MENA Region',
        'Gulf Countries',
        'Gulf MENA Region',
        'Gulf Countries',
        'Gulf MENA Region',
        'Gulf Countries',
        'Gulf MENA Region',
        'Gulf Countries',
        'Gulf MENA Region',
        'Gulf Countries',
        'Gulf MENA Region'
    ],
    'Year': [
        2018, 2018, 2018, 2018,
        2019, 2019, 2019, 2019,
        2020, 2020, 2020, 2020,
        2021, 2021, 2021, 2021
    ],
    'Enrollment_Completion_Rate': [
        93.0, 95.2, 87.2, 90.1,
        80.7, 83.6, 74.2, 78.2,
        65.3, 69.1, 56.8, 60.3,
        66.2, 70.0, 30.7, 37.2
    ],
    'Expected_Years_of_Schooling': [
        12.1, 13.4, 11.8, 12.9,
        12.3, 13.6, 12.0, 13.2,
        11.9, 13.1, 11.6, 12.7,
        12.2, 13.5, 11.5, 12.5
    ]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
colors = {
    'Gulf Countries': '#F28E2B',
    'Gulf MENA Region': '#4E79A7'
}
markers = {
    'Primary Enrollment': 'o',
    'Primary Completion': 's',
    'Lower Secondary Enrollment': '^',
    'Lower Secondary Completion': 'D',
    'Upper Secondary Enrollment': 'v',
    'Upper Secondary Completion': '<',
    'Tertiary Enrollment': '>',
    'Tertiary Completion': 'p'
}

for stage in df['Education_Stage'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Education_Stage'] == stage]
    for region in subset['Region'].unique():
        region_data = subset[subset['Region'] == region]
        plt.plot(
            region_data['Expected_Years_of_Schooling'],
            region_data['Enrollment_Completion_Rate'],
            color=colors[region],
            marker=markers[stage],
            label=f'{region} - {stage}' if region == 'Gulf MENA Region' else "",
            linewidth=0.5
        )

plt.title('Education Attainment vs Expected Schooling Years (2018-2021)', fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Expected Years of Schooling', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Enrollment/Completion Rate (%)', fontsize=12)

handles, labels = plt.gca().get_legend_handles_labels()
by_label = dict(zip(labels, handles))
plt.legend(
    by_label.values(),
    by_label.keys(),
    title='Region - Education Stage',
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1),
    loc='upper left',
    fontsize=10
)

plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
SUMMARY
 The chart is a scatter plot titled "Education Attainment vs Expected Schooling Years (2018-2021)," which visually compares enrollment and completion rates across different education stages in relation to the expected years of schooling. The horizontal axis represents the expected years of schooling, ranging approximately from 11.5 to 13.6 years, while the vertical axis shows the enrollment or completion rate as a percentage, spanning from 30% to just above 95%.

The data points are differentiated by both color and marker shape, representing two regions and various education stages. The Gulf Countries are depicted in a deep blue color, while the Gulf MENA Region is shown in orange. Each education stage is marked by a unique symbol: circles for Primary Enrollment, squares for Primary Completion, upward triangles for Lower Secondary Enrollment, diamonds for Lower Secondary Completion, downward triangles for Upper Secondary Enrollment, left-pointing triangles for Upper Secondary Completion, right-pointing triangles for Tertiary Enrollment, and pentagons for Tertiary Completion.

Notably, Primary Enrollment rates in both regions are the highest, with the Gulf MENA Region reaching about 95.2% at 13.4 expected years of schooling, and the Gulf Countries at 93.0% with 12.1 expected years. Primary Completion rates follow closely, with the Gulf MENA Region at around 90.1% for 12.9 expected years and the Gulf Countries at 87.2% for 11.8 expected years. Lower Secondary Enrollment and Completion rates decrease, with enrollment rates around 83.6% (Gulf MENA) and 80.7% (Gulf Countries) and completion rates around 78.2% (Gulf MENA) and 74.2% (Gulf Countries). The trend continues downward for Upper Secondary stages, where enrollment drops to about 69.1% (Gulf MENA) and 65.3% (Gulf Countries), and completion rates fall to approximately 60.3% (Gulf MENA) and 56.8% (Gulf Countries). Tertiary stages exhibit the lowest rates, with Tertiary Enrollment around 70.0% (Gulf MENA) and 66.2% (Gulf Countries), and Tertiary Completion significantly lower at 37.2% (Gulf MENA) and 30.7% (Gulf Countries). The chart effectively highlights the decline in enrollment and completion rates as the education stages advance, alongside varying expected years of schooling between the two regions.

source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
source = source.replace("'Gulf Countries': '#F28E2B'", "'Gulf Countries': '#4E79A7'")
source = source.replace("'Gulf MENA Region': '#4E79A7'", "'Gulf MENA Region': '#F28E2B'")
source = source.replace("plt.plot(\n", "plt.scatter(\n")
# Match the original plot marker size (6 points) and outline width.
source = source.replace("            linewidth=0.5", "            s=36,\n            linewidths=0.5")
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
ax = plt.gca()
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
print("Axis limits:", ax.get_xlim(), ax.get_ylim())
print("Collections / lines:", len(ax.collections), len(ax.lines))
print("Legend labels:", ax.get_legend_handles_labels()[1])
print("Colors:", colors)
for collection, (_, row) in zip(ax.collections, df.iterrows()):
    expected = (row['Expected_Years_of_Schooling'], row['Enrollment_Completion_Rate'])
    assert tuple(collection.get_offsets()[0]) == expected
print("Verified all 16 plotted coordinates against the source data.")
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
assert df.merge(table, on=list(table.columns), how="inner").shape[0] == 16
print("Verified embedded data matches table.csv.")

        assert collection.get_label() == expected_label
